identity.description: Nonlinear manifold learning: builds a fuzzy k-NN topology of the data and optimizes a low-dimensional layout that preserves LOCAL neighborhood structure. Unrolls curved structure PCA cannot; the price is stochastic fits, unreliable global distances, and no meaningful inverse back to feature space.

consumes.note: unsupervised — no target; the k-NN graph is built from a numeric distance metric (euclidean by default)

emits.note: the low-dimensional layout coordinates. ONE-WAY map: there is no meaningful inverse — inverse_transform exists but is experimental/approximate, so reconstruction is unsupported in this driver. Within-neighborhood distances are meaningful; between-cluster distances are NOT

n_neighbors.note: the local/global dial — small values preserve fine local structure, large values force more global shape into the layout

min_dist.note: minimum spacing in the layout; low values pack neighborhoods tight (cluster-friendly), high values spread them (topology-friendly)

n_components.note: 2 is the visualization default; feed a downstream model 5–20 instead — 2D throws away too much for modeling

metric.note: a data-semantics choice (what 'near' means), not a tunable — pick from the data type, don't search it

invariances.why: the fuzzy topology is built from metric distances — rescaling a feature reweights the metric and rewires the entire neighbor graph
pairwise distances change under nonlinear monotone maps, so the k-NN graph (and hence the embedding) changes
distance computation is undefined on missing entries — the neighbor graph cannot be built with NaN
this driver runs numeric metrics; categorical inputs must be encoded first (custom metrics over mixed types exist in the library but are out of driver scope)

assumes the data is (approximately) uniformly distributed on a locally connected Riemannian manifold — literally the 'U' in UMAP; when it fails, the embedding's apparent densities and cluster sizes are artifacts
needs enough rows for a meaningful k-NN graph — below a few hundred the fuzzy topology is mostly noise; scales well upward via approximate nearest neighbors
a new point is embedded only through its neighbors in the TRAINING graph — a point off the learned manifold has no neighbors that describe it and its placement is unreliable

featureStats.why: UMAP earns its keep exactly when intrinsic dimension is far below ambient dimension — near-full-rank data has no manifold to unroll and PCA-level linear structure is all there is
the fuzzy topology is derived from the k-NN graph — a fragmented graph yields disconnected islands whose relative placement in the layout is arbitrary
with an unstandardized euclidean metric, the biggest-unit feature dominates every distance and the neighbor graph degenerates to a 1-feature ordering

modelMetrics.why: the direct check of the neighborhood-preservation objective — measures whether points near each other in the embedding were truly neighbors in input space
the layout comes from stochastic optimization; if the structure story changes across seeds it is optimizer noise, not manifold signal

edgeCases.condition: NaN anywhere in the input matrix

edgeCases.behavior: library warns and clamps k; the fuzzy topology degenerates toward all-points-are-neighbors
components embed independently — inter-island distances in the layout are meaningless

edgeCases.condition: reading global distances / cluster sizes off the embedding
edgeCases.behavior: between-cluster distances and apparent densities are optimization artifacts, not data facts

deps: umap-learn>=0.5 — HEAVY OPTIONAL dep: pulls numba + llvmlite + pynndescent; import-guarded, NOT in the base sidecar env — driver surfaces a clear 'umap-learn not installed' error when absent
driver.wrapperNeeds: sklearn-compatible fit/transform, but: guard the import (optional dep); do NOT expose inverse_transform (experimental, not meaningful); setting random_state for reproducibility forces single-threaded layout optimization
driver.threadSafety: fit is numba-parallelized (unless random_state is set — determinism costs the parallelism); transform on a fitted model is safe for concurrent reads

placementClaims.why: no native NaN path — distances (and hence the neighbor graph) are undefined on missing values
de-skewing heavy-tailed features tames outlier-dominated distances so the k-NN graph reflects the bulk structure
metric-based mechanism: mixed-unit features must be standardized or the largest-unit column owns the distance and the graph
numeric metric — categoricals must be encoded before 'distance' means anything
